page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7t.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. It features 4 physical cores and 4 vCPUs, with 1.0 thread per core. The memory configuration consists of 8.0 GB of RAM, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates average single-core performance, with a stress-ng single-core score of 1881.08 and a Geekbench single-core score of 1569.0. However, multi-core and memory-intensive operations show significant limitations. The multi-core stress-ng score of 3880.59 and Geekbench multi-core score of 3355.0 fall into the bottom 25% of tested servers. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, with large-block read speeds at 28.84 GB/sec and write speeds at 23.66 GB/sec. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression performance is particularly weak, registering in the bottom 10% at 21.78 GB/sec.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.c7t.xlarge offers a dedicated compute profile with a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, making it an entry-level option for compute-bound tasks that do not require massive memory footprints or local storage. Due to its weak multi-core scaling and database performance, it is less suitable for heavy database hosting or parallelized compilation. It is best aligned with light web serving, single-threaded processing tasks, and basic utility workloads.
